_comment: OBS Background Removal plugin configuration. Apply these settings in OBS → Filters → Background Removal.

model_alternatives.MediaPipe: Low GPU cost, CPU-capable, medium quality — good starting point for low-end hardware
model_alternatives.RVM: Best edge quality (hair, glasses), higher GPU cost

notes: Start with SINet. Switch to RVM only if hair/edges are unacceptable.
Increase threshold (0.5 → 0.7) if too much background bleeds through.
Decrease threshold (0.5 → 0.3) if parts of you are being removed.
Good key lighting separation from background dramatically improves all models.
